## Context / Problem
The tests/e2e cohort contains audited comments or docstrings that obscure current behavior with repetition, obvious narration, duplicated explanation, or historical detail. The audit is pinned to `9e65567b79ffe872534c3c656ade7b34340d8192`.

## Approach
Edit explanatory text only in this directory/subsystem cohort. Condense it to current, non-obvious rationale and constraints; retain every file-specific preserve item and consumer contract below. Grouping adjacent files from one subsystem keeps the change reviewable in one session and permits one coherent verification pass without changing executable behavior.

## Scope
- `tests/e2e/_toolchain.py:1-33, 52-55, 77-80, 140-152, 155-160` — Preserve collection-time provisioning, bounds, lock ordering, optional-browser distinction, and named failures. Consumer: none found.
- `tests/e2e/conftest.py:1-16, 44-47, 56-66, 133-138` — Preserve selection-triggered provisioning and failure re-reporting. Consumer: none found.
- `tests/e2e/test_editor_batch_library.py:1-20` — Preserve real-browser boundary, temporary project root, and four observable guarantees. Consumer: none found.
- `tests/e2e/test_editor_browser.py:1-11, 63-69, 98-101` — Preserve why a real browser is required and each observable behavior. Consumer: none found.
- `tests/e2e/test_editor_e2e.py:1-9, 105-110` — Preserve the real `bpmn-moddle` fidelity boundary. Consumer: none found.
- `tests/e2e/test_editor_library.py:1-11` — Preserve browser boundary and library/create persistence contract. Consumer: none found.
- `tests/e2e/test_toolchain_provisioning.py:1-14, 241-250, 295-302, 387-396, 541-546, 576-581, 610-616` — Preserve deterministic interleaving, lock-order oracle, collection hook, re-report-once behavior, and readiness semantics. Consumer: none found.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every listed location contains only current, non-obvious rationale or constraints after remediation; verified by reviewing the final diff against every Scope row.
- [ ] Every preserve item and consumer contract in Scope remains explicit and accurate; verified by a row-by-row completion comment and the commands under Verification.
- [ ] No executable behavior or test assertion changes; verified by the commands under Verification exiting 0.

## Verification
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint`
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/python scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py`
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest --collect-only tests/e2e/_toolchain.py tests/e2e/conftest.py tests/e2e/test_editor_batch_library.py tests/e2e/test_editor_browser.py tests/e2e/test_editor_e2e.py tests/e2e/test_editor_library.py tests/e2e/test_toolchain_provisioning.py`

The row-by-row diff review is authoritative for prose quality; the hygiene guard detects only its narrow deterministic history-token rule.
